items.clue: Operation AB cos θ on two vectors that gives a scalar.

items.label: Turning point
items.clue: Place where U equals the total E, so the object stops and goes back.

items.label: Stable equilibrium
items.clue: Found at a minimum of U(x): after a slight push the force is directed back.

items.label: Gravitational potential energy
items.clue: Negative quantity belonging to a pair of masses, set to zero at infinite separation.

questions.stem: A probe is moved from a distance R to a distance 3R from the center of a planet of radius R. What fraction of the energy needed to move it from R all the way to infinity is this?
questions.explanation: To infinity: GMm/R. From R to 3R: GMm(1/R − 1/3R) = (2/3)GMm/R. Fraction 2/3.

questions.stem: An ideal spring is stretched slowly from its relaxed length by an external force. Stretching it from 0 to an extension x takes work W. Stretching it further, from an extension x to an extension 2x, takes work nW. What is n?
A car of mass m starts from rest on a level road. Its engine delivers a constant power P to the car, and friction and air resistance are negligible. What is the car's speed at time t?

The potential energy of a system is U(x) = ax² − bx³, where a and b are positive constants and x is the position of an object in the system. What is the x-component of the conservative force exerted on the object when it is at x = d?
